source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Connected Smart Appliances — Third Generation (Job Aid W10785366A)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the appliance or disconnect power before resistance checks and board access. Live voltage steps require controls off and safe access. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Access rear WiFi module
steps.body: Dishwasher smart delta: HMI + WiFi only (no PM board). WiFi module at rear bottom; SAID/MAC on enclosure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Dishwasher smart delta: HMI + WiFi only (no PM board). WiFi module at rear bottom; SAID/MAC on enclosure.

steps.title: WiFi LED during CONNECT
steps.body: Run connect process. Observe LED through plastic enclosure (no window). Green fast blink = module active.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run connect process. Observe LED through plastic enclosure (no window). Green fast blink = module active.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace WiFi module or check antennas after harness inspection.

steps.title: Check dual antennas
steps.body: Verify internal radio antenna and external tub antenna routed to UI area per §7-3.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify internal radio antenna and external tub antenna routed to UI area per §7-3.

steps.title: Service Diagnostics cycle
steps.body: Standby: press 1-2-3-1-2-3-1-2-3 within 1 sec between keys. Close door to start cycle. Note: WiFi fault sends error to ACU but no WiFi status step in diagnostics.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Standby: press 1-2-3-1-2-3-1-2-3 within 1 sec between keys. Close door to start cycle. Note: WiFi fault sends error to ACU but no WiFi status step in diagnostics.

steps.title: Dishwasher WiFi path OK
steps.oemOutcome: LED and antennas verified — HAN/registration issues are customer network scope.

steps.title: Replace WiFi module or HMI
steps.oemOutcome: Inspect harness before board replacement; do not replace WiFi and HMI together unless required.
